description: Deterministic native Page Builder content composer (G3 issue #23, G4 issue #25): composes persisted master-format HTML from a pinned NodeIR/PageStructure/registry/manifest — pure computation, no filesystem, no network, no write operations. Composes exactly FOUR bounded section shapes, detected per section and driven by explicit role evidence, never guessed: the hero shape (full-width background media + overlaid text + CTA) as native row(contained) > banner(poster), the two-column shape (one column-primary + one column-secondary projected slot container) as the declaration-backed chain row(contained) > column-group(default) > column-line > column(full-height) x2 with role-resolved text folded into a text(default) WYSIWYG and projected inline-media slots as image(full-width) elements — column-line is the declaration-mandated bridge and observed side-by-side media pairs compose stacked with explicit fidelity gaps (nesting a column-group inside a column violates the pinned policies); the issue #28 column-grid shape (explicit grid-column projections: Rule B split = one explicit slot + ONE synthesized complement column from the section's remaining loose composable content; Rule A grid = 2+ slots grouped into lines by observed common parent + vertical overlap bands, widths apportioned from observed fixed widths to integer percents, loose text clusters compose as leading/trailing text bands, projected grid-captions attach by geometric containment); and the issue #28 text-band shape (loose role-resolved text/CTA content without background media or column structure, guarded so media-carrying or structured containers honestly skip instead of being flattened), emitted as row(contained) > text(default) WYSIWYG [+ buttons(inline)]. Projected CTA instances compose in every column-bearing shape as the declaration-backed buttons(inline) > button-item(default) pair (label + link from the manifest, buttonVariant hint maps to the platform button_type class; no manifest link -> explicit gap, never an unlinked pseudo-button), verified against the pinned declarations and the canonical editor-saved content of the target checkout before use. Hero overlay min-height and two-column styles persist via the platform's rehydratable style-block mechanism (deterministic data-pb-style keys + leading <style> rules the Admin stage parses back into form fields; issue #25 NAN/12 correction) — the Admin reader overwrites inline style attributes, so widths/min-height are never emitted inline in this shape. Native targets are verified against the pinned registry first; every planned source node is accounted for in the mapping (mapped / gap / decoration-merged / excluded / skipped); missing content inputs and non-representable arrangements come back as NOT_VERIFIED gap warnings — never invented around, never embedded as arbitrary HTML. Structural composition evidence only: no Admin round-trip or visual claim.
